name: Meals on Wheels Contra Costa
description: Meals on Wheels Contra Costa is a Martinez-based nonprofit that funds home-delivered meals for homebound seniors across Contra Costa County and connects seniors with the three local partners that deliver the meals.
fullDescription: Meals on Wheels Contra Costa is a Martinez-based nonprofit that funds home-delivered meals for homebound seniors across Contra Costa County and connects seniors with the three local partners that deliver the meals.
whatTheyOffer:
- Help connecting to a local meal delivery provider
- Meals delivered by partners - Meals on Wheels Diablo Region (county-wide, 925-937-8607), J-Sei (Japanese cuisine; Concord, Pleasant Hill, Walnut Creek, El Cerrito, Richmond, Kensington; 510-654-4000 ext. 105), and Meals on Wheels West Contra Costa (Richmond, San Pablo, Pinole, Hercules, and nearby; 510-412-0166)
- Funding that helps shorten waitlists for homebound seniors
howToGetIt: You must be 60 or older and homebound, unable to buy or prepare nutritious meals, with no one else to do so for you. To sign up, call the delivery partner that serves your area, or contact Meals on Wheels Contra Costa at (866) 669-6697 or info@mowcontracosta.org for help getting connected.
keywords: Meals on Wheels, Contra Costa, home delivered meals, senior meals, homebound, disabled, Diablo Region, West Contra Costa, J-Sei
